title.rendered: Products can be collected at the National AGM on 21st March 2026

content.rendered:
This is a reminder that if you are attending the National AGM at the White Horse, London, SW6 4UL on 21st March you can collect products there, avoiding the cost of post and packing.

Please email ‘products@spbw.beer’ with your order and you will be given the reduced prices and details of how to pay.

We do have a small amount of stock on hand, but anything else will need the usual 4 weeks notice to supply, so if you could please submit your order by 12 noon on Friday 20th February at the latest. 

After that, you may be lucky and require something we already have in stock, so it is worth an email to find out.

(LA)
